officialTitle: AI, Scientific Discovery & Software Engineering — Q&A

chapters.title: Where could AI and supercomputing help medicine?
Regulation, medical data and informed consent
Connecting medicine, mathematics and software skills
Do decision records create a maintenance burden?
What happens when only some teammates use AI?
Can academia keep pace with AI development?

existingSummary: Zak Allal and Muhammad Waseem discuss continuous hearing, architecture decision records, and the role of AI and supercomputers in research. Audience questions lead to a discussion of medical applications, controlled experiments, privacy, multidisciplinary collaboration, the maintenance cost of decision records, mixed AI use in teams and academia’s changing role.
